name: Free Shoe and Bag Scheme
benefit: Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided for purchasing shoes and bags for boys and girls as follows: - ₹318/- per student for Classes 1 to 5 - ₹462/- per student for Classes 6 to 8 The amount is transferred directly to the students' account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a student of Classes 1 to 8 studying in any government or non-government aided school in Uttarakhand.
